name: MOT_SALES_ACCT_TEMP_FILTERS
description:
This entity is introduced to enhance performance when showing Sales Accounts in the Territory Manager UI ( ie Dimension shuttle)
It is used in flows where it is necessary to filter the sales account dimension by the values for the other dimensions selected for the Territory in context.
It holds the user entered values for the chosen dimensions and related sequence number information.
Data in this table is temporary and will be purged as soon as the user completes the selection of the sales account.
Note: The data will be purged in a separate process in cases where data remains i the table when the user terminates
the application by any other means.

columns.name: TERR_DIMENSION_CODE
columns.description: Refers to Terr Dimension Code in MOT_TERR_DIMENSIONS_B table.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_LOW
columns.description: Sequence Low for dimension member, used by Assignment Manager to identify territory which should be selected for given dimension.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_HIGH
columns.description: Sequence High for dimension member, used by Assignment Manager to identify territory which should be selected for given dimension.

columns.name: UNSPEC_FLAG
columns.description: Used in generating a separate predicate for 'Unspecified' dimension members. Valid values are 'Y' and 'N'.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
